title: Falsifiable Adaptive-Relaxation Method Specification for Package 171-R7

scientific_hypothesis.problem_statement: Package 171-R1 undamped Picard iterations (omega_d = 1.0) exhibited monotonic coupled divergence (delta_d grew by 4.44x from iter 9 to 23). Package 171-R6 convex damping (omega_d = 0.5) eliminated divergent oscillations and enabled 98.84% active-set contraction (13,803 -> 160 nodes), but stalled at a slow linear contraction plateau (rho ~ 0.9892, delta_d = 8.31e-3, shedding 8.7 nodes/iter) requiring >700 iterations to achieve delta_d <= 1e-5.
scientific_hypothesis.falsifiable_solution: Two-phase safeguarded relaxation: Phase 1 maintains conservative convex damping (omega_d = 0.5) during rapid active-set boundary shedding. Upon verified active-set membership stabilization (|Delta A_k| <= 2 for 3 consecutive iterations), Phase 2 activates candidate relaxation omega_d = 0.85. If damage-increment growth exceeds 5% (delta_d_{k+1} > 1.05 * delta_d_k), the trial state is reverted to omega_d = 0.5, enforcing strict damage bounds, zero healing, and history consistency.
falsification_conditions: If Phase 2 relaxation omega_d = 0.85 triggers non-convergent oscillations or residual divergence despite rollback safeguards.
If active-set membership fails to stabilize (|Delta A_k| > 2 indefinitely) even after cardinality reaches <200 nodes.
If force or energy discrepancy exceeds 2.0% relative to donor reference.

phase_1_relaxation.objective: Suppress crack-tip strain-damage oscillatory feedback during large active-set contraction

phase_2_candidate_relaxation.activation_condition: Measured active-set membership changes |Delta A_k| <= 2 for 3 consecutive iterations (k, k-1, k-2)

active_set_telemetry_and_membership_crit.telemetry_requirement: Telemetry stream must record node-resolved active-set membership changes (symmetric difference count |Delta A_k| = |A_k \ A_{k-1}| + |A_{k-1} \ A_k|) in addition to scalar cardinalities |A_k| and |F_k|.
active_set_telemetry_and_membership_crit.cardinality_vs_membership_distinction: Cardinality stability (|A_k| = |A_{k-1}|) is insufficient because internal node churning can preserve cardinality while shifting boundaries. Membership stability explicitly bounds symmetric difference.

safeguard_rollback_mechanism.rollback_action: Revert trial update d^{k+1} to conservative relaxation (omega_d = 0.5), reset Phase 2 counter, and resume Phase 1 damping.

bounds_and_physical_continuity.history_monotonicity: H^{k+1} >= H^k pointwise across all 61,008 integration points
bounds_and_physical_continuity.kkt_evaluation: Explicit post-relaxation KKT stationarity recomputation under corresponding H^{k+1}

epistemic_limits_and_scientific_discipli.spatial_coordinates_logging: Scalar telemetry stream logs only max-norms and set sizes; per-node spatial coordinates are absent. Notch-root localization is a mechanics-based physical expectation, NOT an authenticated direct empirical observation in the solver log.
epistemic_limits_and_scientific_discipli.convergence_rate_conjecture: Convergence in 35-50 iterations under omega_d = 0.85 is an empirical acceleration target, NOT a proven mathematical guarantee. Actual iteration count remains to be observed experimentally.
